scope: Independent numerical convergence and native area-cache precision for Box3 and HeldPrism5
rule_change: Eight-point and sixteen-point Gaussian quadrature over the same local B-spline spans

observations.conclusion: Increasing quadrature order does not explain the native-cache gap; the native area field is a numerical approximation. Keep exact BRep comparisons separately and use the native mass-cache precision class for its area field

notes: The convergence differences use conservative decimal summaries of the exact values shown in the two remote runs. The relative gaps use the first-run values. The native controls are distinct fresh saves, so their last bits differ. No production fallback, donor value, or per-case fitted table is introduced
